purpose: Freeze the completed NEW Regression Runner installation and RR7 operational cutover state, keep the legacy V2 comparator outside automatic ownership, and define the exact evidence required before RR9 physical retirement without manufacturing synthetic workload proof.

rollbackCloseout.reason: RR6 shadow and RR7 operational proofs establish the NEW runner and cutover, but the operational proofs so far were generated by regression-runner tooling/checkpoint changes. Keep the manual OLD comparator until one legitimate post-cutover non-regression-runner-tooling workload exercises the inherited legacy automatic scope successfully.
rollbackCloseout.rr9AfterProof: Create an exact runtime-retirement inventory before deletion. Retire only OLD operational/runtime surfaces proven unnecessary, such as the manual V2 workflow, legacy admission runtime script, and its package entrypoint if still dedicated. Preserve historical V1/V2 contracts, summaries, and validation evidence unless the exact inventory separately proves they are runtime-only and safe to archive or remove.

reviews.detail: The OLD manual V2 comparator still contains the RR0-frozen stale SHA admission policy. It is not authoritative for the NEW runner and does not block NEW operation.
A legitimate post-cutover workload proof is still required only before RR9 physical retirement. Do not manufacture a synthetic change solely to obtain this proof.

nextStart: Continue normal project work or the next independent-tool reinstall while the Regression Runner rollback window remains open. Start RR9 only after a legitimate post-cutover non-regression-runner-tooling workload produces a successful NEW operational run with nine-validator parity, zero tracked mutation, no OLD automatic PR run, and no dual automatic runner. Then inventory exact OLD runtime-only surfaces before physical retirement.
reopenConditions: The NEW operational Regression Runner fails a selected validator or tracked-state guard.
OLD Regression Coverage Promotion V2 regains an automatic pull_request trigger.
Both OLD and NEW automatic regression runners become active simultaneously.
The R3 validator catalog or core-regression-v1 membership changes.
The regression-runner check is proposed as a required branch-protection context.
New authoritative evidence proves the RR0 legacy admission drift represents semantic corruption.
